Title: Retrieve all customers sharing the same phone number
Preconditions: At least two customers exist in the system with the same phone number (e.g., '5551234567')
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/customers/by-phone with the query parameter 'phone' set to a valid phone number shared by multiple customers (e.g., '5551234567').

Test Data: Query parameter: phone=5551234567
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Customers retrieved successfully", "data": [<list of customer objects>]}. The 'data' array contains all customers with the specified phone number, each including fields: 'id', 'name', 'phone', and 'gender'.
